Starbucks brought in $37.2 billion in fiscal 2025 (year ended Sept 28, 2025), but its highest-margin segment has no cafes: Channel Development, the packaged-coffee business run largely through Nestle, kept a 47.3% operating margin versus 11.5% for North America. This video breaks down Starbucks' three segments, company-operated versus licensed stores, the roughly $7 billion Nestle prepayment, Starbucks Rewards and prepaid balances, and the margin drop to 7.9% in fiscal 2025. It then walks through Brian Niccol's Back to Starbucks plan with dated facts, the Boyu Capital China joint venture, and results for the quarter ended June 28, 2026 (GAAP and adjusted margins). Worked examples use figures from Starbucks' own filings.
